surface.description: Where the event came from. Sent on every event, $pageview included. The local web app, desktop and the server never send events (ADR-024, ADR-090).

app_version.description: The x.y.z version of the build that sent the event: the web build's version on the landing page and the portal, the app version on the phone. Sent on every event.

locale.description: The interface language when the event was sent. Sent on every event.

environment.description: Where the build that sent the event runs (ADR-236): production only for a release build on a production host (the web) or a release build of the phone app. Analytics is off everywhere else unless POSTHOG_ENABLED=true forces it on to check the integration, and those events say development. Sent on every event.

$pageview.description: A landing page was viewed. Sent by posthog-js in cookieless mode with the shared properties and the landing `$` allowance of docs/analytics/README.md rule 1 (URL, UTM, referrer, device type and the SDK's control properties), which every landing event shares; a referrer from the local app (/app) is dropped (ADR-090). No other properties.

landing_cta_clicked.description: A call to action on the landing page was clicked.

app_first_opened.description: Sent once per signed-in person on this phone, right after their first opt-in (which may come later, from Settings). The 'already sent' flag is cleared with the other flags on sign-out or account switch. Nothing is sent before a person opts in, so earlier opens are never counted.

portal_opened.description: The hosted portal was opened by a signed-in person who has turned on anonymous usage.

analytics_opted_in.description: A person turned on anonymous usage. A new random ID is created first, so this is the first event under it.

prompt.description: Turned on from the one-time prompt (first_run) or from the toggle (settings): Settings on the phone, the account menu on the portal.

analytics_opted_out.description: A person turned anonymous usage off. The last event under the random ID: captured, flushed with anything already queued, then sending stops and the ID is reset (MUT-153 D5). Signing out resets without sending it.

client_created.description: A client was created on the phone. Clients are created online only, so this fires when the server confirms the create, never on a failed attempt. The portal does not create clients.

income_recorded.description: An income entry was saved. Phone: on the local save, so offline entries count when they are made. Portal: when the server confirms the save (personal profile only, MUT-133).

currency.description: The entry's currency code. Never the amount.

paid.description: Whether it was saved as already paid.

expense_recorded.description: An expense was saved. Phone: on the local save. Portal: when the server confirms the save.

currency.description: The expense's currency code. Never the amount.

payment_recorded.description: A payment received was saved. Phone: on the local save. Portal: when the server confirms Record payment.

currency.description: The payment's currency code. Never the amount.

trial_card_prompt_shown.description: MUT-418: the free trial's card prompt was shown: the first-run step, or the Home banner (once per page view). Opt-in only (ADR-090), so first-run counts are partial; users.trialPrompt holds every answer.

trial_card_prompt_accepted.description: MUT-418: the person chose to add a card from the trial's card prompt (it opens Subscribe, then Stripe Checkout with the rest of the trial).

trial_card_prompt_skipped.description: MUT-418: the person declined the trial's card prompt: Not now (or closing) on the first-run step, or hiding the Home banner for 3 days.

setup_passkey_offered.description: MUT-619: right after a setup link set the password and signed in, /setup offered Create a passkey (a device that can make one, an account with no passkey and a MUT-370 offer left). Opt-in only (ADR-090), so counts from brand-new accounts are partial; users.passkeyPrompt holds every Not now.

link.description: Which setup link set the password: an operator's setup link, a reset or recovery link, or a self-signup link.

setup_passkey_created.description: MUT-619: Create a passkey on the setup step registered one (the server answered 201).

link.description: Which setup link set the password: an operator's setup link, a reset or recovery link, or a self-signup link.

setup_passkey_not_now.description: MUT-619: Not now on the setup step; it spends one of MUT-370's three offers and hides the Home card for 30 days.

link.description: Which setup link set the password: an operator's setup link, a reset or recovery link, or a self-signup link.

setup_passkey_not_created.description: MUT-619: Create a passkey on the setup step ended without one; the step stays, with Try again and Not now. Errors themselves go to Sentry (MUT-146).

link.description: Which setup link set the password: an operator's setup link, a reset or recovery link, or a self-signup link.

reason.description: cancelled = the person closed the system sheet (or it timed out); offline = MTB3A couldn't be reached; other = the device or the server refused.

report_viewed.description: MUT-175: Reports was opened, or its period or scope changed (debounced 1 s). MUT-448: also the account-level Glance, told apart by layer. Never amounts, names or profile ids; signed out never sends.

layer.description: MUT-448: glance = the account-level Reports across every profile (/reports); profile = one profile's Reports (/p/:id/reports).

scope.description: One profile, or All profiles combined. Sent with layer profile only.

stage.description: How much history the report had: stage_1 = no complete month, stage_2 = one, stage_3 = two or more. Sent with layer profile only.

portal_welcome_choice.description: MUT-513: a door on the portal's first-visit welcome was chosen. Sent before anyone signs in, cookieless like the landing (its own instance, nothing stored, ADR-230): the only portal event sent without consent, and nothing else about the visitor.

choice.description: sign_in = Sign in; signup = Create an account; local = Try it on this device.

billing_offer_shown.description: MUT-525: the launch offer was shown to a person who gets it: in the Billing drawer (its offer line) or on the Home trial line. Once per page view per place. Never amounts.

offer.description: Which offer: the /v1/billing offer id with dashes as underscores.

place.description: drawer = the Billing drawer; banner = the Home trial line. Named place because surface is a shared property.

billing_checkout_started.description: MUT-525: Continue to payment opened a Stripe Checkout (the server made the session; the browser is leaving for Stripe). Never amounts.

interval.description: The plan chosen: monthly or yearly.

currency.description: The Checkout's currency code, from the billing country. Never the amount.

offer.description: The offer the drawer showed and sent with this Checkout. Absent when none applied.

plan.description: MUT-565 / MUT-705: which plan the Checkout is for. Absent means freelancer (builds before 2.8.0).

accountant_plan_offer_shown.description: MUT-565: the Accountant plan was offered: the 4th-client card on the invite, a locked client's prompt, or the plan's line in Billing. Once per view per place. Never amounts, ids or the address.

place.description: invite = the accept page's 4th-client card; client_books = a locked client's prompt on the client list; billing = the Accountant plan line in Billing. Named place because surface is a shared property.

accountant_invited.description: MUT-561: an owner invited an accountant to read one of their profiles, or invited an expired one again (the server answered 201). Never the address, the name or the profile. The phone adds itself in MUT-563.

accountant_revoked.description: MUT-561: an owner stopped an accountant's access or cancelled a pending invite (the server answered 204, or the grant was already gone). Never the address, the name or the profile. The phone adds itself in MUT-563.

was.description: pending = an invite not yet accepted was cancelled; active = an accountant's access was stopped.

accountant_accepted.description: MUT-575: an accountant accepted an invite; sent by the accountant's client after the accept or the signup from the invite answers.

via.description: signed_in = accepted while signed in to an existing account; signup = a new account made from the invite.

accountant_left.description: MUT-575: an accountant chose Stop reading on a client; sent after DELETE /v1/clients answers 204 for an active client (not for removing an ended one).

share_link_created.description: MUT-575: an owner made a share link to a period of a profile; sent after the create answers 201. Never the link, its PIN or the profile.

period.description: The period the link shows, as the API names it in lower case.

expires_in_days.description: How long the link lives: 1, 7 or 30 (the create request's expiresInDays).

share_link_revoked.description: MUT-575: an owner revoked a share link; sent after the revoke answers 204.

share_link_opened.description: MUT-575: a visitor unlocked a share link with its PIN on the link page; sent after a successful unlock. Whether the link page may send without consent is decided with MUT-562.

period.description: The period the link shows, as share_link_created names it.

period_downloaded.description: MUT-575: a period's report or receipts were downloaded; sent after the MUT-314 download answers 200. Never the profile or a date.

place.description: owner = the owner's own profile; client_books = an accountant's client; link_page = a share link's visitor. Named place because surface is a shared property.

file.description: report = the period's report; receipts = its receipts archive.

months.description: How many calendar months the period spans, 1 to 24.

sign_in_code_requested.description: MUT-618: "Email me a sign-in code" sent its ask and the server answered (the answer says nothing about whether the address has an account). Sent before anyone signs in: cookieless on the portal, like portal_welcome_choice; on the phone only with the usage choice on.

resend.description: true when it was "Resend code" on the code step.

sign_in_code_signed_in.description: MUT-618: a person signed in with an emailed code. Cookieless on the portal, as sign_in_code_requested.

sign_in_code_refused.description: MUT-618: the server refused a typed code. Not an error: what the person does next. Network and server failures go to Sentry instead.

reason.description: wrong = a try was spent; expired = no live code (expired, used or replaced); too_many_tries = the fifth wrong try killed it; rate_limited = the address or network must wait; under_review = the right code on an account waiting for review.

save_moment_closed.description: MUT-627: the full-screen save moment after a save in the app closed. Shown = the sum of every outcome. An undone entry is never counted as income_recorded or expense_recorded.

outcome.description: confirmed = Confirm or back; auto_confirmed = the 6-second countdown ran out; undone = Undo (nothing was sent); backgrounded = the app left the foreground mid-countdown (kept).

entry_point.description: Where it was saved. receipt_review shows a Done-only moment, so its outcome is always confirmed.

plan_cap_reached.description: MUT-731 / MUT-733: a plan's limit was reached: the portal showed its notice (from a 409 PLAN_LIMIT, or from the month's usage before the person typed). Once per page view per limit.

limit.description: Which limit: the monthly documents or scans, the businesses count, partners, or the Tax Authority connection.

plan.description: MUT-733: the plan whose limit was reached.

plan_upgrade_offered.description: MUT-731: Upgrade to Solo was shown with a limit's notice (only where a paid plan can be bought on the server). Once per page view per limit.

limit.description: The limit whose notice offered it.

plan_upgrade_chosen.description: MUT-731 / MUT-705: Upgrade to <plan> was pressed (Billing's Subscribe step on that plan; Billing's Change plan for a subscriber). Never an amount.

from.description: The plan the person was on.

plan_gift_shown.description: MUT-733: a paid plan's monthly limit was reached for the first time and the once-ever gift was shown (the Issue drawer, the receipt upload). Once per page view per limit.

limit.description: The meter whose limit was reached.

plan_gift_accepted.description: MUT-733: Continue on the gift recorded it; the held request was sent again.

limit.description: The meter the gift lifts this month.

plan_change_previewed.description: MUT-734: a plan was picked in Billing's Change plan and its preview read (the amount charged now, or the date). Never an amount.

from.description: The plan the person is on.

plan_change_confirmed.description: MUT-734: a plan change went through: applied (or waiting for the bank) for an upgrade, scheduled for a downgrade or a move to Starter. Never an amount.

from.description: The plan the person was on.

kind.description: Up now, down at the period end, or to Starter at the period end.

plan_change_undone.description: MUT-734: a scheduled plan change was taken back before its day (Billing's Undo or the toast's).

onboarding_plan_shown.description: MUT-737: a new account's first-run plan step was shown (the web's Try Solo / Stay on Starter, the phone's Starter step). Once per account.

onboarding_plan_chosen.description: MUT-737: the first-run plan step was answered. The phone sells nothing, so it only ever sends starter.

choice.description: solo = Try Solo (the one-time trial's Checkout); starter = Stay on Starter.

starter_continue_chosen.description: MUT-731: after a cancel, the person chose Continue free on Starter on the read-only banner or in Billing.

pilot_billing_opened.description: MUT-758 (pilot): only while GET /v1/billing returns `pilot` (an operator grant with a cohort); the cohort itself is never sent (free text). Billing was opened with the Pilot panel. Once per opening.

pilot_plans_viewed.description: MUT-758 (pilot): only while GET /v1/billing returns `pilot` (an operator grant with a cohort); the cohort itself is never sent (free text). The panel's plans (Expected prices and limits) came into view. Once per opening.

pilot_contact_tapped.description: MUT-758 (pilot): only while GET /v1/billing returns `pilot` (an operator grant with a cohort); the cohort itself is never sent (free text). The panel's Write to us link was pressed.

pilot_first_scan_saved.description: MUT-758 (pilot): only while GET /v1/billing returns `pilot` (an operator grant with a cohort); the cohort itself is never sent (free text). A scan was saved while `pilot.firstScanAt` was null: the tester's first scan. Once per account (the next billing read has the date).

hours_since_start.description: Whole hours from `pilot.startedAt` to the scan.

pilot_first_invoice_issued.description: MUT-758 (pilot): only while GET /v1/billing returns `pilot` (an operator grant with a cohort); the cohort itself is never sent (free text). A document (any type) was issued while `pilot.firstInvoiceAt` was null: the tester's first invoice. Once per account.

hours_since_start.description: Whole hours from `pilot.startedAt` to the issue.

pilot_usage_near_cap.description: MUT-758 (pilot): only while GET /v1/billing returns `pilot` (an operator grant with a cohort); the cohort itself is never sent (free text). A usage line in the panel reached 90% of its Business limit (it turns butter; nothing is refused). Once per opening per line.
